eyebrow.zh: 陽明交大土木系 · 防護工程

title.zh: 讓結構在爆炸與衝擊下，依然站得住。
title.en: Keeping structures standing through blast and impact.

lead.zh: 我們結合爆炸試驗、數值模擬與先進防護材料，為關鍵基礎設施、國防設施與產業廠房，提供抗爆評估、防護設計與快速修復方案。
lead.en: We combine explosive testing, numerical simulation and advanced protective materials to assess, protect and rapidly repair critical infrastructure, defense facilities and industrial plants.

figCaption.zh: Friedlander 爆炸波形：我們從荷載開始，一路算到結構會不會倒。
figCaption.en: The Friedlander blast wave: we follow the load all the way to whether the structure survives.

figAria.zh: 爆炸超壓與時間的關係圖，顯示峰值超壓、正壓相與負壓相
figAria.en: Blast overpressure versus time, showing peak overpressure, positive phase and negative phase

note.zh: 100 kg TNT、爆心離地 1 m、距建築物 15 m；以 Kinney–Graham 經驗式計算入射與反射超壓場（示意，未含繞射與 Mach 波細節）。
note.en: 100 kg TNT, 1 m above ground, 15 m from the building. Incident and reflected overpressure from the Kinney–Graham relations (illustrative; diffraction and Mach-stem details omitted).

aria.zh: 爆炸波從爆心向外傳遞、撞擊建築物並反射的壓力場動畫
aria.en: Animation of a blast wave expanding from the charge, striking a building and reflecting

desc.zh: 從材料抗壓、衝擊試驗，到真正的縮尺爆炸試驗，親眼看結構怎麼破壞。
desc.en: From material and impact tests to scaled explosive tests: see with your own eyes how structures fail.

desc.zh: LS-DYNA、BlastFoam 等業界與國防單位使用的軟體，畢業前就能獨立建模。
desc.en: Learn LS-DYNA, BlastFoam and other tools used by industry and defense agencies, and build your own models.

desc.zh: 研究題目來自國科會、國防與產業計畫，做出來的東西會被真正用上。
desc.en: Topics come from NSTC, defense and industry projects, so your results are put to real use.

lead.zh: 從威脅情境、材料研發、力學與爆炸試驗、數值模擬，到工程應用與驗證，建立完整的研究鏈。
lead.en: A complete chain from threat scenarios, material development and testing to simulation, engineering application and validation.

title.zh: 把爆炸風險，變成可以計算、可以驗證的工程問題。
title.en: Turning blast risk into an engineering problem you can calculate and verify.

lead.zh: 透過國立陽明交通大學產學合作與技術服務機制簽約執行。
lead.en: Contracts are executed through NYCU's industry collaboration and technical service programs.

sectorsTitle.zh: 依產業找到你需要的服務
sectorsTitle.en: Find the service for your sector

need.zh: 設施防護設計審查、戰損評估與快速修復
need.en: Protective design review, damage assessment and rapid repair

need.zh: 抗爆設計檢核、補強方案與第三方審查
need.en: Blast design checks, retrofit schemes and third-party review

need.zh: 爆炸情境模擬、超壓分布與安全距離評估
need.en: Explosion scenarios, overpressure maps and safety distances

need.zh: 抗衝擊與抗爆性能驗證試驗，取得可引用數據
need.en: Impact and blast qualification tests with citable data

title.en: Want to talk about a research topic?

lead.zh: 歡迎大學部專題生、碩士班與博士班同學來信，或直接到工程二館 321 室找我們。
lead.en: Undergraduate, master's and Ph.D. applicants are welcome to email us or visit Room 321, Engineering Building II.
